freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the vibe adapter's output over the conformance scenario at harness 2.22.0 (second IMAGE rung; newer end of the image release-delta 2.9.5 -> 2.22.0). vibe uses the preprocess path: preprocess_vibe.py normalises the native session directory (meta.json + messages.jsonl) into a container array, which vibe.dsl.yaml turns into one trace per session; dsl_runner's multi-trace path stamps content_hash itself (verify.py asserts the stamp and must NOT re-run back-fill, per cross_trace R2). verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count. vibe traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the content_hash is checkout-independent.
capture_provenance: Live container capture on the arm64 capture workstation (2026-07-25) via the version-pinned image built from frameworks/vibe/ (pip mistral-vibe==2.22.0, python:3.12-slim, linux-arm64), routed to the arm64 capture workstation's ollama (qwen3:8b) through vibe's GENERIC provider backend (api_style=openai, api_base=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 — no socat: vibe honours the configured api_base with no localhost preflight). qwen3:8b emits real function_call items (qwen2.5* emit tool calls as TEXT). Unattended approval via the --auto-approve flag (2.19-era flag surface). Scenario s1-count: 'Count the lines in data.txt and write just the number to count.txt' (data.txt has 4 lines). Format era confirmed 2.9-era in-band (title_source / parent_session_id / loops present in meta.json). Host brew vibe untouched.
